en-US:
This build completes the privacy manifest coverage required for App Store review: the app, the Screen Share extension and every bundled framework now declare the required-reason APIs they actually use, and unknown or undeclared usage fails the packaging step. System language is read through public APIs again, with language and region kept independent (for example English (US) with an Australian region keeps en_AU formatting). Feedback images now reach the feedback service under the screenshot field it expects. The in-app storage check decides supported filesystems through public APIs and keeps uncertain volumes unsupported rather than guessing.
Local shell note: native find -fstype reports that it is not supported in this build, wc still counts real bytes, and tail follow mode polls; the matching Linux guest tools are unchanged.
zh-Hans:
本构建完成 App Store 审核所需的隐私清单覆盖：应用、屏幕共享扩展与全部内置 framework 都按其真实调用的必需理由 API 声明清单，未知或未声明的调用会直接使打包失败。系统语言重新通过公开 API 读取，语言与区域保持独立（例如英文(US)加澳洲区域仍使用 en_AU 格式）。反馈图片现在按反馈服务期望的字段上传。应用内存储检查改用公开 API 判定文件系统，无法确认的卷保持“不支持”，不做猜测。
本地 shell 说明：本构建中原生 find -fstype 会明确提示不受支持，wc 仍按真实字节计数，tail 跟随改为轮询；Linux 客体中的对应工具未改动。
